title: Noor, hospital courier

greeting.text: The bell. A woman in hospital scrubs under a parka, car keys still in her fist.
Is the road east open? Tell me it's open. I've an esky in the car that has to be in Tarrow by six.

annoyed: Every minute you stare at me, that esky gets warmer.

notes.wrist: A hospital lanyard round the wrist. Under it: blue, branching, in a hurry.
notes.reflection: Her back in the mirror, turning to the door every time she does.
notes.shadow: One shadow. It fidgets when she fidgets.

topics.answer: A kidney. For a nine-year-old. So you'll understand that I'm not in the mood.

topics.ask: Did anything try to stop you on the way up?
topics.answer: A kid. Standing on the centre line with its arms out. I didn't stop. I'm a nurse, and I didn't stop. Don't ask me again.
No. You'll open it, and then it's medical waste, and then I'll be the one telling her mother why.

topics.ask: Then go. Don't let me keep you.
topics.answer: ...Thank you. You're the first thing tonight that's got out of my way.

wren.adviceLine: She can't drive in that. Put her in the back, Sam. I'll look after her, and her little box.

after.shelter: She's resting. The box is in the drinks fridge. I had a look inside. I only wanted to see what one looks like.
after.serve: You let her take it. All right. All right. It was only curiosity.

serve.text: The road's shut, but nobody is on it. Keep to the centre line and don't stop for anything.
I know. God help me, I know.

shelter.text: You can't drive in this. Wait out the back till it's light.
Six o'clock. Wake me at five. Promise me.

walkout.text: I don't have time to be looked at.

report.serve: A transplant courier reached Tarrow Base Hospital at twenty to six. The surgery is under way. She asked us to thank whoever told her not to stop.
report.turnAway: A hospital courier's car has been found on the pass with its hazard lights on. The esky on the passenger seat was still cold.
report.walkout: A hospital courier's car has been found on the pass with its hazard lights on. The esky on the passenger seat was still cold.
report.shelter: Tarrow Base Hospital reports a transplant has been cancelled. The organ did not arrive.
report.missed: A hospital courier waited at Corrigan's for the road to open. It did not open.
